variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: 10/4.5x54R
variants.info:
An obscure Zarovian cartridge that can be loaded in 7.62x54mmR weapons including your SVDS!
It is a dart encased in a sabot allowing it to fly incredibly fast with great potential in penetrating softer materials but not great at shooting limbs due to overpenetration!
Very powerful headshot damage and fast fire rate!

variants.name: 9.6x53mm
variants.info:
Load your SVDS with 9.6x53mm LANCASTER.
 A large Zarovian caliber designed for the general public. Adjusted performance fitting for the round being fired.
